nom: ANUA KPop Demon Hunters Ultra-Thin Spot Cover Patch

avis.texte: Probably my most favorite pimple patches ever. It’s affordable and working just fine like other brands out there. Also, I’m a big fan ANUA products so thats just right in the alley. I also like that it’s a little thinner than the other popular ones.

My daughter's and I have use several different patches and really like these. They dont irritate the skin and reduce the blemishes. They are easy to apply and they are not to thick to were it feels heavy on the face. Really good price, ordered 4 more boxes for stocking stuffers.

avis.titre: Very happy with these acne patches!
avis.texte: Very happy with these acne patches! They are nearly invisible when I have them on and they significantly help to soothe my problem areas. I appreciate the different sizes for different areas and found them to be a great value!
They are amazing!! They actually stick. I love that when I pull them off, the zit looks better and smaller. Will definitely buy again!!

These are my favorite pimple patches so far. I tend to wear them under my makeup if I have a little friend popping up. I typically can’t tell I have one because they are pretty invisible as long as it’s properly placed and not stuck together. Good product.

Im not sure how its supposed to work because the words are all in a different language. I do however love the face that I cant touch the spot that us being protected. Its pretty thin and I dont wear heavy makeup. I dont use it everyday but it at least covers the spots needed

THE BEST PATCHES! I love this patches for the skin benefits it provides. The appearance is almost invisible and the color is perfect. Provides the necessary relief for acne, hydration and shortens the time of acne presence. 10/10
This is an okay product. I believe the adhesive is very strong and a more sensitive skin may react.
One of the best acne patches I have ever tried. They are really thin, and works wonders. It helps with the spot and at the same time it calms the redness. Worth the price.

I had a whole conversation with my tween and about these pimple patches without realizing she was wearing three of them. They are by far the most transparent pimple patches I have seen. They adhere well and come with a generous amount. There are two different sizes as well. These will definitely be a new favorite based on how well they camouflage blemishes!

I’ve tried countless pimple patches over the years, and this one is by far the best! I applied it to a zit, and it completely disappeared in less than 24 hours, which was quite surprising. (I didn’t remove or change the patch during that time.) The patch is very thin and clear, but still slightly noticeable, so I wouldn’t recommend wearing it outside. Overall, these are great pimple patches.

These stick quite well and one of the reasons is that there aren't any small ones. I don't like the small 8mm ones so this kit has the 10mm at the smallest which is my minimum preference. The ceramides and cica also helps calm your skin and heal redness faster which is great. Always better than just standard hydrocolloid patches with nothing else

These Anua patches are really thin. I have combo sensitive skin and breakout around my lips. I have a pimple starting on the corner of my lip, so trying this out in the late afternoon. I changed out a new patch around 9pm. The next morning, I had a white head, popped that baby, so the patch worked. Now I just need to wait til the pimple finished its ending life cycle.

I like these Anua pimple patches. They come in different sizes and are wrapped in packs of 15. I like that it includes soothing ingredients like cica, cermaides, and aloe. Sometimes the patches with salicylic acid can feel more irritating to an already irritated breakout.

The ANUA Ultra-Thin Spot Cover Patches are good for inconspicuously covering a spot. The patches are thin and are almost transparent when in use. My trouble is with getting the patches off the plastic. They are hard to remove, and I ended up flinging the first one to the floor. The second one folded in on itself, making it unusable. When I finally got one on, it was like it wasn't there. It is comfortable, and I had no adverse reactions. Overall, it is a good option for spot treatment.
